name: Vayakan
body:
Vayakan CR 4

XP 1,200
LN Medium outsider (extraplanar, lawful)
Init +6; Senses blindsight 50 ft., darkvision 50 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural)
hp 43 (6d10+10)
Fort +3, Ref +8, Will +6
Defensive Abilities 10 ft. antimagic field

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee longsword +9 (1d8+4)
Special Attacks
Special Attacks antimagic ray

STATISTICS

Str 18; Dex 15; Con 14; Int 13; Wis 14; Cha 15
Base Atk +5; CMB +9 (+17 grapple); CMD 22
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes
Skills Diplomacy +12, Knowledge (planes) +14, Perception +14, Sense Motive +13, Stealth +10
Languages Celestial, Common

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

at will, antimagic field, 10-ft. radius

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Utopia)
Organization single, duality (2), trinity (3), multiplicity (4-12)
Treasure standard (longsword and other treasure)

Vayakan, also known as nulling spirits, are entities that dwell in the lawful neutral plane of Utopia, where they serve as part of the bulwark against Limbo’s chaotic presence. Vayakan are usually seen in the Prime Material as emissaries, or because the nulling spirit has been sent on a mission. Outside of the Material plane, vayakan serve as ambassadorial guards for the allies of Utopia, as their antimagic field allows them to protect vulnerable beings from the harshness of the other planes.

Vayakan exist to serve the purpose of Order, and will obey their instructions to the exact specifications they are given. This can create problems for normal mortals, as vayakan think and understand the Planes very differently than a non-outsider.

The primary defense of the vayakan is their innate ability to generate an 10 foot antimagic field. This ability is unaffected by standard Planar Modifiers, and continues to function in the Demiplanes, as well as the Inner, Outer, and Transitive planes.

Vayakan are 6 feet tall and weigh 170 pounds. They appear as ghostly, wraithlike humanoids that emit a seething blue glow. The vayakan’s antimagic field also appears as this same bluish haze.
